name: 맞혀 보기 퀴즈
inspired_by: 퀴즈 쇼츠 — 문제·보기 → 생각할 시간 → 정답 공개
use_when: Let viewers guess a key fact from the article before revealing it (a deadline, an amount, a rule people often get wrong). Question + 2-4 options, the answer is revealed when the narration says it. Great as a short-form hook or a mid-video attention reset.
avoid_when: The fact is not surprising, or the correct answer is not stated in the article. More than once per video.

answer.desc: 1-based index of the correct option (must be the fact stated in the article/narration)

note.desc: one-line reason shown after the reveal

examples.narration: 考一題：取得證照之後，最晚幾天內要申請獎勵金？三十天、六十天，還是九十天？答案是九十天，超過就一毛都拿不到。

data.question: 取得證照後，最晚幾天內要申請？
